methodologyNotes: Re-verified 2026-06-18 via WebFetch on each vendor's official pricing page (getrecharge.com/pricing/, boldcommerce.com/shopify/subscriptions-pricing, loopwork.co/pricing, skio.com/pricing, apps.shopify.com/subscriptions-by-appstle, sealsubscriptions.com/pricing, www.smartrr.com/pricing, stay.ai/pricing) plus compliance/trust pages where available. All eight vendors confirmed real with live pricing pages; every published monthly platform fee corroborated exactly to the draft. Per-transaction / per-GMV fees recorded in plan.notes (these are telephony-field-free ecommerce apps; telephony fields null). Quote-only enterprise/custom tiers carry monthlyUsd null. compliance flags set true only where the vendor explicitly states the standard; otherwise null. accessedAt 2026-06-18 throughout. No vendors removed; no fabrications found; the draft proved highly accurate.
